title: Matte White Towel Bar, 18-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass Straight Bar, Carolina Collection, Allied Brass
description:
Keep towels neatly within reach while maintaining a clean, classic bathroom look with a wall-mounted towel bar built for everyday use in Matte White, which brings clean, fresh simplicity that brightens spaces and creates a light, airy bathroom atmosphere. Crafted from solid brass with concealed screw mounting, this straight bar design delivers a refined finish and space-saving storage.

- Create an organized towel spot at the sink or shower
- Clean, finished look with concealed mounting hardware
- Wall mount design saves space in smaller bathrooms
- Coordinates with classic bath accessories in the Carolina Collection
- Backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty

Specs: 18-inch center-to-center; 20 in overall length x 2 in depth x 3.5 in height; 0.75 in diameter bar; weight capacity 10 lb; wall mount with concealed screws; includes towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware (screws #8 x 1 1/4").
